title: Bar Chart
description: Columns for comparing a handful of values — the chart people read correctly at a glance.
usage: For comparing categories: weeks, plans, channels. Keep it under a dozen bars, label every value, and highlight at most one bar — the one the reader should remember.
a11y: A chart is a picture of numbers: give the figure role="img" and an aria-label that states the conclusion ("Signups rose from 22 to 71 over the year"), and keep the data available as a table nearby.
